chapters.title: Chapter 927: Drunken Master
paragraphs: In the Operating Area, a pot of money plant was cleaned thoroughly with alcohol-based hand sanitizer. It was hung on the wall, and it showcased its fresh, beautiful plastic leaves. It looked even purer than an actual money plant.
A few nurses from the Department of Surgery whispered as they walked back and forth. Their expressions were anxious and solemn as if there was an impending battle.

To the nurses in Yun Hua Hospital, such public surgeries were just like a practical exam. Even though they would not get commended for scoring good grades, they would definitely get scolded so badly by the head nurse that white hair started growing on their heads if they screwed things up.

In the bathroom not far away, the sound of flowing water became softer and softer before coming to a stop. The young nurses slowed down. They might have either done this intentionally or unintentionally. They lingered in the room and glanced at the door every now and then.
*Creak*
A pair of long arms opened the door. Next, a long pair of legs stepped out.
Everyone held their breaths as they gazed at Ling Ran. Their beauty standards were rising exponentially, they had more faith in humanity, and they loved life more than ever.
“Is the patient here yet?” Ling Ran opened a bottle of water and gulped it down.

“He’s wheeled into Operating Theater 1 already. Doctor Su is keeping a watch on him.” An elderly nurse from the Department of Surgery gazed hungrily at Ling Ran, who had just finished showering. She gulped without realizing and said, “Doctor Ling, don’t drink too much water. What if you pee your pants during the surgery?”
“It won’t take that long,” Ling Ran answered in a steady voice.
The young nurses gave the middle-aged nurse a vicious look, and this made the other party shiver.
“Isn’t she too old for such thick makeup?”
“She’s an old b*tch. An old pug, maybe.”
“Why would Doctor Ling pee his pants? He doesn’t even need to go to the toilet!”

Ling Ran did not stay for long in the waiting room. He straightened up his clothes and headed to the hand-washing room. He washed his hands as he asked Zuo Cidian, who had walked toward him obediently, “How’s the patient’s mood?”
As it was a public surgery, Ling Ran had read various reports and other information related to the patient beforehand. Hence, Zuo Cidian did not need to explain anything.
Compared with these hard facts, the patient’s emotional state was something to be concerned about.

Zuo Cidian chuckled when he heard Ling Ran’s question. “The patient’s mood is pretty stable. It’s just that his family members made a request. It’s a relatively strange request, but I think that we can take it into consideration...”
“What request?” Ling Ran had always been concerned about his patients’ requests.

Actually, most doctors who were used to doing major surgeries had a similar habit. It could be said to be a realization as well. This was because major surgeries were risky, and the probability for the surgery to be completed smoothly was low. There were plenty of times where a perfect ending was not possible. Hence, due to the circumstances, it was a humane thing to do to fulfill the patient’s request so that the ending was not too bad.

A more typical example would be gastrectomy. Total gastrectomy was getting rarer and rarer nowadays, and it was not because subtotal gastrectomy brought about a better result with less residual cancer cells. It was because the patients’ quality of life after total gastrectomy would be horrible. Hence, many of the times, patients and their doctors were more willing to go for subtotal gastrectomy.
However, total gastrectomy was commonly seen in hospitals in areas where medical care was not advanced.

Zuo Cidian washed his hands carefully and said, “As you already know, the patient is only forty-two this year, and he’s still a middle-aged man. So, his liver probably got into this state because of how much alcohol he drank. The patient’s family member, his wife, wants a chunk of the patient’s liver. She said that she wants to soak that chunk of liver in a bottle of spirit and put it on display at home so that the patient could be reminded every day of the dangers of drinking.”
“She wants to bring the removed chunk home?” Ling Ran processed the information.
Zuo Cidian nodded. “That was what she meant.”
“Does the hospital policy allow it?”

Zuo Cidian said, “This kind of thing is relatively rare in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. At most, patients would just take a few of their liver stones home. Patients in the General Surgery Department don’t usually make this kind of request either... Nowadays, the Gynaecology Department allows the patient’s family members to bring the placenta home. So, theoretically, it wouldn’t be against the hospital’s policies for the patient’s family member to bring a chunk of liver home.”
“What does the patient think?” Ling Ran asked.
Zuo Cidian hesitated for a moment and said, “I have not asked the patient yet.”
“If the patient is conscious and congruent, we will do as the patient wishes. Go ahead and ask him about it now.” Ling Ran had a clear train of thought.

Zuo Cidian understood what Ling Ran meant, and he immediately added, “I’ll type out an informed consent form for this. I’ll then let the patient and his family member sign it. After we obtain consent from both of them, we’ll soak the liver chunk in an organ-preservation solution after it’s removed during the surgery.”
Ling Ran nodded a little.
Zuo Cidian was done washing his hands. He wiped his hands dry with a towel and entered an operating theater.

After a while, Ling Ran entered the operating theater with his hands up. He heard the patient muttering with a myriad of emotions in his voice. “What’s wrong with drinking? Why would you soak my liver in spirit? Do you think that drinking is the only thing that destroyed my liver? Has she forgotten about how I accompany her to the karaoke in the middle of the night all the time? Has she forgotten about how I broke the law and drove her home even though I was dead drunk? Does she really think that I single-handedly destroyed my kidney?”
Ling Ran looked at Zuo Cidian with a baffled expression.
“Cadres who drink on the job all the time are really something. Not even anesthetics work on him.” Zuo Cidian clicked his tongue and gestured at the patient with his mouth. “Try something else.”
Beside him, Su Jiafu was a little flustered as he looked for other anesthetics to administer.

Different people reacted differently to anesthetics. It was very common for females to be more resistant to anesthetics. The patient on the operating table was not just resistant to anesthetics. Even though he was no longer congruent, his consciousness did not fade away.

Even though he might get knocked out with some additional drugs, the anesthetist could not just randomly administer some other anesthetic. And this was when the inadequacies of Su Jiafu the young resident doctor from the Department of Anesthesiology showed.
He had rarely encountered this kind of situation.
Unfortunately, this was a public surgery. He could not just administer some random anesthetic, as it would reflect badly on him if the patient’s vitals were to go haywire.
Su Jiafu was considered mentally strong, as he did not make a call and ask for help immediately.

Ling Ran did not know much about anesthesiology, and he did not urge Su Jiafu to hurry up. He merely looked around at the medical staff members who looked slightly anxious and said, “Let’s play a song.”
Ling Ran encountered anxious medical staff members all the time. He would not usually console them directly, as the medical staff members would just become even more anxious.
Hence, he would usually play a song when the staff members in the operating theater were anxious. This could be easily done in the operating theater.
Wang Jia the young nurse immediately walked over to the wall and pressed a few buttons. Soon, a Cantonese song rang out of the speakers.
“When life turns upside down, I go into a higher realm... I swing my fist in style, all the charm in the world belongs to me... Just get as drunk as you want, as life is best when you’re drunk...”
Zuo Cidian immediately recognized the song from his era. “Drunken master?”
“It fits the context, doesn’t it?” Wang Jia was very pleased with herself.
Zuo Cidian saw that the patient on the operating table had started to sway along to the music. He shrugged. “As long as you’re happy.”
“You mean, as long as Doctor Ling’s happy. This song’s rhythm is pretty good, isn’t it?” Wang Jia looked at Ling Ran.
Ling Ran said nonchalantly, “Whatever goes. Doctor Su?”
“No problem. I’ll settle this immediately.” Su Jiafu took a deep breath. “The public surgery won’t be delayed.”

That was when the patient on the operating table started to mutter again, “I never delayed anything. I go to work on time and get off work on time. It’s just that I drink one catty of beer in the afternoon, but I always gargle before I go home. I even do the dishes...”
Su Jiafu’s expression hardened, and he pumped a vial of anesthetics into the patient’s veins. “This is your last time ever getting high. You’ll have to stop drinking alcohol after this...”
The patient’s breaths finally became even.
Ling Ran had already put on a pair of scrubs and a pair of gloves. He nodded. “You guys can activate the cameras now. We’re getting started.”
“The surgery was planned to be under four hours.” Zuo Cidian stood beside him and whispered, “If four hours aren’t enough, I’ll get someone to make arrangements for more time.”
Ling Ran had already practiced on a Virtual Human just now, and he shook his head with assurance. “One and a half hours would be enough.”
After performing combined liver and pancreatic radical surgery, Ling Ran’s concept of time when it came to hepatectomy changed again.
Zuo Cidian could not help but snicker. “One and a half hours would be just right. If you do it too quickly, the audience might not be able to understand what’s going on.”

He heard the patient muttering with a myriad of emotions in his voice.
“What’s wrong with drinking?
Why would you soak my liver in spirit?
Do you think that drinking is the only thing that destroyed my liver?
Has she forgotten about how I accompany her to the karaoke in the middle of the night all the time?
Has she forgotten about how I broke the law and drove her home even though I was dead drunk?
Does she really think that I single-handedly destroyed my kidney?”
Ling Ran looked at Zuo Cidian with a baffled expression.
“Cadres who drink on the job all the time are really something.
Not even anesthetics work on him.” Zuo Cidian clicked his tongue and gestured at the patient with his mouth.
“Try something else.”
Beside him, Su Jiafu was a little flustered as he looked for other anesthetics to administer.
Different people reacted differently to anesthetics.
It was very common for females to be more resistant to anesthetics.
The patient on the operating table was not just resistant to anesthetics.
Even though he was no longer congruent, his consciousness did not fade away.
Even though he might get knocked out with some additional drugs, the anesthetist could not just randomly administer some other anesthetic.
And this was when the inadequacies of Su Jiafu the young resident doctor from the Department of Anesthesiology showed.
He had rarely encountered this kind of situation.
Unfortunately, this was a public surgery.
He could not just administer some random anesthetic, as it would reflect badly on him if the patient’s vitals were to go haywire.
Su Jiafu was considered mentally strong, as he did not make a call and ask for help immediately.
Ling Ran did not know much about anesthesiology, and he did not urge Su Jiafu to hurry up.
He merely looked around at the medical staff members who looked slightly anxious and said, “Let’s play a song.”
Ling Ran encountered anxious medical staff members all the time.
He would not usually console them directly, as the medical staff members would just become even more anxious.
Hence, he would usually play a song when the staff members in the operating theater were anxious.
This could be easily done in the operating theater.
Wang Jia the young nurse immediately walked over to the wall and pressed a few buttons.
Soon, a Cantonese song rang out of the speakers.
“When life turns upside down, I go into a higher realm...
I swing my fist in style, all the charm in the world belongs to me...
Just get as drunk as you want, as life is best when you’re drunk...”
Zuo Cidian immediately recognized the song from his era.
“Drunken master?”
“It fits the context, doesn’t it?” Wang Jia was very pleased with herself.
Zuo Cidian saw that the patient on the operating table had started to sway along to the music.
He shrugged.
“As long as you’re happy.”
“You mean, as long as Doctor Ling’s happy.
This song’s rhythm is pretty good, isn’t it?” Wang Jia looked at Ling Ran.
Ling Ran said nonchalantly, “Whatever goes.
Doctor Su?”
“No problem.
I’ll settle this immediately.” Su Jiafu took a deep breath.
“The public surgery won’t be delayed.”
That was when the patient on the operating table started to mutter again, “I never delayed anything.
I go to work on time and get off work on time.
It’s just that I drink one catty of beer in the afternoon, but I always gargle before I go home.
I even do the dishes...”
Su Jiafu’s expression hardened, and he pumped a vial of anesthetics into the patient’s veins.
“This is your last time ever getting high.
You’ll have to stop drinking alcohol after this...”
The patient’s breaths finally became even.
Ling Ran had already put on a pair of scrubs and a pair of gloves.
He nodded.
“You guys can activate the cameras now.
We’re getting started.”
“The surgery was planned to be under four hours.” Zuo Cidian stood beside him and whispered, “If four hours aren’t enough, I’ll get someone to make arrangements for more time.”
Ling Ran had already practiced on a Virtual Human just now, and he shook his head with assurance.
“One and a half hours would be enough.”
After performing combined liver and pancreatic radical surgery, Ling Ran’s concept of time when it came to hepatectomy changed again.
Zuo Cidian could not help but snicker.
“One and a half hours would be just right.
If you do it too quickly, the audience might not be able to understand what’s going on.”

chapters.title: Chapter 928: Positive Energy
paragraphs: “What Doctor Ling is performing right now is the Pringle maneuver, which he often uses to interrupt hepatic blood flow. Based on the analysis report of the 1,500 cases of hepatectomy he had done, the prognosis for the patients who received the Pringle maneuver is among the top... Doctor Ling uses some special techniques when it comes to the interruption of hepatic blood flow. As we can see...

“The presence of gastric varices is extremely bad for hepatectomy. Because of this patient’s habit of long-term alcohol consumption, he also has other symptoms such as gastric ulcer and gastrorrhagia. But his gastric varices aren’t very serious... Hm, when it comes to dealing with gastric veins, Doctor Ling has some special techniques. We can visibly observe that...

“Portal hypertension is one of the most important things to watch out for during hepatectomy, and it is also something difficult to deal with. Many doctors are very careful with patients with portal hypertension. Of course, we are also very careful with patients with portal hypertension. However, Doctor Ling has some special techniques when it comes to dealing with patients with portal hypertension. As all of you can see...”

Yu Yuan was standing at the frontmost of the visitation room. She was akin to a superhero who was good at being invisible, as she was so short that people could barely see her. She spoke in a loud voice and explained every single detail of the surgery to the audience.
At the same time, Yunli Medical Company had also hired professional videographers to live-stream the entire surgery together with Yu yuan’s commentary.

Yunli Medical Company had been doing an increasing number of such live streams, so the videographers were already very skilled at them. Even though they were unable to capture Yu Yuan’s figure, her voice could be heard perfectly in the stream.
As for the audience, today’s surgery felt rather dramatic.

At first, they would look nonchalant as they were mere spectators. After that, they would look annoyed because of how much Yu Yuan was speaking, and they felt like they already knew about what Yu Yuan was explaining. They would then look irritated, because Yu Yuan always stopped once she revealed sufficient information instead of everything that she knew, because she obviously knew more than what she said. In the end, they would be shocked at how high the standard of the surgeries nowadays was. Yu Yuan could see the change in the audience’s expression, and it stimulated her so much that the more she spoke, the more excited she became.
Hospital Director Bo was a little excited too. All doctors would be naturally excited to see almost perfect surgery.
This was especially true when he looked at Lao Yongyong, the primary care physician of Tonca Group who was sitting beside him. He even felt a little proud of Ling Ran.

It was a strange state of mind. Whenever Huo Congjun and the others boasted about Ling Ran in front of Hospital Director Bo, Hospital Director Bo would have a slight desire to rebel. But now that he was dealing with the arrogant primary care physician of Tonca Group, the situation was reversed.
Not only was boasting about Ling Ran psychologically satisfying for Hospital Director Bo, but it was also good for his business.

“Doctor Lao, isn’t Doctor Ling, whom I have introduced to you, really good at hepatectomy? Truth be told, even if you were to get a doctor from Mayo Clinic, he might not be better than Ling Ran,” Hospital Director Bo whispered to Lao Yongyong as he stared at the large screen before him. There was a slight smile on his face, and there was a boastful pride in his voice, which was typical of businessmen.

Lao Yongyong was more focused on how boastful Hospital Director Bo was. He decided to turn Hospital Director Bo’s words against him and laughed out loud. “We all know how excellent doctors in Mayo Clinic are. Forget about the ordinary doctors there, but if we were to compare ourselves with the top doctors there, it’s obvious that the doctors in China still have plenty of room for improvement. Just take a look at the five-year survival rate of liver cancer patients who received treatment in Mayo Clinic, and then at the five-year survival rate of locally treated liver cancer patients. Hehe...”

“Mayo Clinic is excellent as a whole, and they aren’t renowned because of a single good surgeon,” Hospital Director Bo retorted amiably and continued with an underlying meaning in his words, “Even if you were to hire a surgeon from Mayo Clinic to operate on this patient, without his corresponding team from Mayo Clinic, the patient’s prognosis might not be as good as how it would be if he was treated by this team in Yun Hua Hospital. You have probably taken a look at the data related to Ling Ran’s team, isn’t it? Whether it is ordinary hepatectomy or hepatectomy for patients with liver cancer, the patients’ five-year survival rate is basically perfect. He’s a gifted child of God indeed...”
“I don’t believe in talent. I don’t believe that people are either talented or not talented.” Lao Yongyong waved in dismissal, and there was absolute certainty on his face.

Unlike primary care physicians in Europe and the United States, primary care physicians like Lao Yongyong made a name for themselves through the trust of the family they serve. After serving that family for a long time, they would slowly elevate themselves to that family’s status.
However, compared with the primary care physicians of rich and powerful families in developed countries, Lao Yongyong’s abilities left a lot to be desired for.

After all, if Lao Yongyong was capable of rising to a higher position such as department director or even chief physician, he would not have become the private doctor for a private enterprise like Tonca Group. Even though highly skilled doctors of his age would need to fight hard to become the personal physicians of leaders, being the primary care physician of powerful families was nothing but a leftover job.

Hospital Director Bo was even starting to suspect that Lao Yongyong was privately working together with another medical intermediary. After all, Lao Yongyong was absolutely adamant in defending American doctors, a little too adamant, actually. Even if he were to speak highly of foreign doctors, he did not have to speak highly about American doctors. Other countries like Japan, Germany, and the United Kingdom had renowned and highly skilled doctors too. It was also easier to work together with doctors from those countries.
However, Hospital Director Bo had no choice but to keep his suspicions in mind and not vocalize it.

If he were to refute Lao Yongyong with this speculation, Lao Yongyong would just attack him and say that he was not capable enough to provide medical services of an equal standard. Of course, it was true that Hospital Director Bo did not have many American contacts. But he had no intention of revealing this weakness.

“Doctor Lao, why don’t you forward the footage of Doctor Ling’s surgeries to the foreign doctors that you want to invite? Let’s see how they respond to those footages.” Hospital Director Bo tried to convince Lao Yongyong from another perspective.
However, Lao Yongyong’s expression changed. He looked insulted as he said furiously, “Are you trying to say that I do not understand Doctor Ling’s maneuvers?”
“No, you’ve misunderstood my intentions.” Even though Hospital Director Bo shot down the notion, he immediately understood something. ‘This old thing doesn’t understand Doctor Ling’s maneuvers.’

Hospital Director Bo immediately became exasperated and upset at the same time. He had forgotten about how Lao Yongyong had never made a name for himself for being skilled back when he was working in a government hospital. People in the field of medicine used to talk about how he was good at nothing but “maintaining a patient’s health”...

Hospital Director Bo had no particular dislike for this kind of person. In his opinion, there are a lot more unskilled doctors than skilled doctors in the world, and the existence of unskilled doctors was only natural. Even if an untalented doctor were to try his best to catch up with other doctors and become an average doctor, no one would be impressed by his skills. Even if a doctor was among the top ten percentile of all the doctors in the world, he would be nothing but ordinary in the eyes of a patient in a tertiary Grade A hospital.

Lao Yongyong was quite old, and he had long since ceased to be a frontline doctor. Back when he was working in a hospital, he might not even have performed hepatectomy. Even if he had done so, the maneuvers that they used back then were a lot different than the modern ones. He may have also forgotten everything.

When he thought of that, Hospital Director Bo became even more confident. He looked solemnly at Lao Yongyong and said, “Doctor Ling is definitely one of the most skilled liver surgeons in the world. The director is hiring a doctor who can save his life, so I think that we need to look at the bigger picture.”

Hospital Director Bo’s gaze became sharper and sharper as he spoke. Even though he was a medical intermediary, his job involved the lives of people, and being a yes man would not do his business any good.

Lao Yongyong felt a little bit uncomfortable when Hospital Director Bo looked at him like that. He took a deep breath and said in a slightly more amicable tone, “Aren’t we taking him into consideration right now?”
“Then, you would have to take information from various sources into account,” Hospital Director Bo said and looked at the screen again.

Lao Yongyong did not bother to say anything either. He was also looking at the screen. Ling Ran’s hands which were clad in a pair of blue gloves were moving nimbly as he made a surgical knot. For some reason, Lao Yongyong felt glum when he saw this.

chapters.title: Chapter 929: Imposing Aura
paragraphs: “If any of you has a question, you can voice it out any time.” From the moment Yu Yuan picked up the mic, she had no intention of putting it down. She sounded excited, and she was in high spirits. It was her time to shine, and her expression kept changing. It did not matter that other people could not see her face. Every movement of hers was energetic, and her facial expression was lively.

“If you encounter a problem, you can talk to one of our staff members. You can ask questions whenever the mic is in your hands.” During the surgery, Yu Yuan deliberately paused her commentary with the intention of interacting with the audience.

In the original plan, interactions had to be managed very carefully. This was not an entertainment show, and even though it was a public surgery, there was an ill patient involved. Even though surgeons chatted all the time, they had to be careful when deliberately communicating and interacting with the audience.
The publicity specialists from Yunli Medical Company had even come up with a few plans for Yu Yuan, and there were staff members who were on standby to intervene with the live stream at any time.
However, none of the things people in Yunli Medical Company were worried about happened.
Not only were the interactions done carefully, but they were also rare.
The ones who asked questions were mostly less renowned doctors instead of the renowned and highly-skilled doctors who came to watch the surgery with the intention of shooting down Ling Ran.
Half an hour into the surgery, the audience did not think much about this situation yet. But when the surgery was almost ending, all of the more experienced doctors understood what was going on.

“This is Ling Ran’s might.” Huo Congjun had been keeping watch of things in Prosperous Fountain Hotel today. He exited the biggest conference room in the hotel and entered a small waiting room. He then rested both of his hands on his waist and laughed maniacally.
“What do you mean by authority?” Doctor Zhou decided to play along with Huo Congjun.

“The lion is the king of the jungle, and dragons are kings of the fantasy realm. As doctors, we should also have the kind of authority that could be used to silence and subdue other people in certain aspects.” Huo Congjun was pleased with himself. “You will know what I mean after watching the recording of the preoperative discussion we had today. There were a bunch of doctors who specialized in hepatectomy, and none of them dared to ask Ling Ran anything as they were worried that someone might spot their weaknesses. The doctors who asked questions were less renowned doctors, and all of them had a humble tone. They wanted to learn something from Ling Ran. It was a really satisfying sight...”
Doctor Zhou smiled. “It’s just like the way things are when you gave a speech during the seminar earlier.”

Huo Congjun flashed Doctor Zhou an approving smile, and he was so happy that he was smiling from ear to ear. “That’s a different story. Ling Ran is truly good at hepatectomy. A thousand five hundred cases of hepatectomy are no joke, you know. From what I know, many doctors can only achieve this after working all their lives. And their results are not even as good as that of Ling Ran. This public surgery is basically going perfectly. It might be because of our adequate preparation, and it might also be because the patient is still young. Everyone would have nothing but praise for it. As for me, even though I often have the authority to silence and subdue other people...”
“Your name is known far and wide. Other people are scared of you, but they respect you at the same time.” Doctor Zhou played along with a smile.

Behind Doctor Zhou, a resident doctor who looked so ordinary that other people had trouble remembering his name had the urge to whip out his notebook and note down what Doctor Zhou had just said. He muttered, “He’s definitely a clever portrait artist.”

All the doctors around him nodded in unison. Take a portrait artist who was drawing the portrait of a king who was missing a leg and an eye for an example. Even if the portrait artist were to draw him as a king with two long and healthy legs, no matter how good the portrait looked, it would just be a lie. But if you were to draw a portrait of the king hunting with one leg propped on a stone and one eye hidden behind the gun, it would be perfect.

When it came to Huo Congjun, if you were to praise him and say that he was able to silent and subdue everyone with his skills, it would not hide the fact that he was missing an eye. It might even sound like mockery. All the resident doctors made up their minds to learn the craft of flattery from Doctor Zhou in the future. Ling Ran’s skills were too hard to learn, after all, and Doctor Zhou’s skills seemed like a more practical choice...

Huo Congjun was in a pretty good mood. He satisfied his desire to boast in front of Doctor Zhou and the other doctors for a bit more. When he was in the massive conference room just now, he had no choice but to sound humble so that he could make Ling Ran look better. He had suppressed his desire to boast for a long while.
After boasting for a few minutes, Huo Congjun turned and looked at Doctor Zhou. “Why are you still in the waiting room? Aren’t there a lot of work in the hospital today?”

“I have given the emergency hotline a call. I told them to send the patients who are not seriously ill to other hospitals such as Yun Hua Provincial Hospital. Doctors from one and a half treatment groups are in the emergency room, and that’s enough.” Doctor Zhou paused for a moment and laughed. “I asked them to transfer more patients to other departments, so even though all of them have things to do, they aren’t too busy. They’re in a very good mood now.”

“Hmm, this is a good thing too. We no longer need to take in so many headache and fever patients either. Since we’re an Emergency Medical Center, we must make it a point to act like a ‘center’.” Huo Congjun agreed. However, he looked at Doctor Zhou again and said, “But we have to try our best to treat all the patients that we’re capable of treating. Don’t just simply transfer patients to other departments. What should we do in the future if everyone gets too used to transferring patients to other departments?”
“Yes, you’re right.” When Doctor Zhou saw that Huo Congjun was no longer focusing on the fact that he was slacking instead of working in the hospital, he could not help but flash a smile.
In the operating theater, Ling Ran answered the questions that rang out from the intercom every now and then.
Ma Yanlin and Lu Wenbin who were acting as assistants could not help smiling. They were pleased with themselves.
Many of the questions were what they have asked before. Now, they already know the answers.

Since both of them were busy acting as assistants, they had no time to think about why only less renowned and junior doctors were asking questions. But when they heard these doctors asking questions that they already knew the answers to, they felt happy because of various reasons.
“Hmm, let me check on things for a moment.” Ling Ran asked for a pair of scissors and snipped off the last surgical thread. He then checked on everything from beginning to end.
The assistants immediately suppressed their feelings of happiness and checked on things along with Ling Ran.

As for Yu Yuan, who was giving an explanatory commentary in the visitation room, she stopped the question and answer session. As she held the mic, she lowered her voice naturally. “Doctor Ling is very careful when operating on patients, and after he completes the surgery, he has high standards when checking on things. All the assistants would be anxious at this time...”
“What would Doctor Ling do if you guys fail to carry out the checking process well?” a doctor in the visitation room suddenly asked out of curiosity.
Aside from the junior doctors, many doctors whose eyelids were heavy from sleepiness also looked at her in curiosity.
Even though all surgeons scolded other people in the operating theater, everyone wanted to know how other surgeons did it.

Yu Yuan was also at a loss of words when she heard this question. She thought carefully about it for a long while and said, “Usually, when we fail to spot a problem, Doctor Ling will jump in and assist.”
“How about punishment?” An elderly man could not stop himself from smiling from ear to ear. “Does he spank his assistants’ buttocks?”

Yu Yuan shook his head a little. “From what I can remember, Doctor Ling almost never punished anyone. If someone does something wrong, he would point out the mistake. And then, I guess the person who made the mistake would feel guilty and ashamed.”
“What on earth does this mean?” The elderly man did not understand what Yu Yuan was saying at all.

Yu Yuan looked at the person who spoke and could not help but smile. “I guess it means that Doctor Ling just has this imposing aura about him that would make his subordinate take the initiative to work hard.”
The elderly man laughed out loud. “I think all this talk about imposing auras is bullsh*t. Let me tell you, it’s more normal for surgeons to have a hardened heart and speak vicious words.”
As he spoke, the elderly man rose and pressed the intercom button. He said with a smile, “Doctor Ling.”
“Yes?” Ling Ran’s voice was steady. He raised his head to look at the visitation room.
The elderly man saw Ling Ran’s sharp gaze as he looked downward, and the words he intended to say were immediately stuck in his throat. “What was I trying to say again?”
Ling Ran was already done with the surgery. He furrowed his eyebrows and reprimanded the elderly man. “Those who are not involved in the field of medicine, don’t press the intercom button.”
The elderly man squirmed uneasily, and he just had to say, “I’m sorry, erm...”
Ling Ran gestured, and with a beep, the circulating nurse in the operating theater ended the conversation.

In the original plan, interactions had to be managed very carefully.
This was not an entertainment show, and even though it was a public surgery, there was an ill patient involved.
Even though surgeons chatted all the time, they had to be careful when deliberately communicating and interacting with the audience.
The publicity specialists from Yunli Medical Company had even come up with a few plans for Yu Yuan, and there were staff members who were on standby to intervene with the live stream at any time.
However, none of the things people in Yunli Medical Company were worried about happened.
Not only were the interactions done carefully, but they were also rare.
The ones who asked questions were mostly less renowned doctors instead of the renowned and highly-skilled doctors who came to watch the surgery with the intention of shooting down Ling Ran.
Half an hour into the surgery, the audience did not think much about this situation yet.
But when the surgery was almost ending, all of the more experienced doctors understood what was going on.
“This is Ling Ran’s might.” Huo Congjun had been keeping watch of things in Prosperous Fountain Hotel today.
He exited the biggest conference room in the hotel and entered a small waiting room.
He then rested both of his hands on his waist and laughed maniacally.
“What do you mean by authority?” Doctor Zhou decided to play along with Huo Congjun.
“The lion is the king of the jungle, and dragons are kings of the fantasy realm.
As doctors, we should also have the kind of authority that could be used to silence and subdue other people in certain aspects.” Huo Congjun was pleased with himself.
“You will know what I mean after watching the recording of the preoperative discussion we had today.
There were a bunch of doctors who specialized in hepatectomy, and none of them dared to ask Ling Ran anything as they were worried that someone might spot their weaknesses.
The doctors who asked questions were less renowned doctors, and all of them had a humble tone.
They wanted to learn something from Ling Ran.
It was a really satisfying sight...”
Doctor Zhou smiled.
“It’s just like the way things are when you gave a speech during the seminar earlier.”
Huo Congjun flashed Doctor Zhou an approving smile, and he was so happy that he was smiling from ear to ear.
“That’s a different story.
Ling Ran is truly good at hepatectomy.
A thousand five hundred cases of hepatectomy are no joke, you know.
From what I know, many doctors can only achieve this after working all their lives.
And their results are not even as good as that of Ling Ran.
This public surgery is basically going perfectly.
It might be because of our adequate preparation, and it might also be because the patient is still young.
Everyone would have nothing but praise for it.
As for me, even though I often have the authority to silence and subdue other people...”
“Your name is known far and wide.
Other people are scared of you, but they respect you at the same time.” Doctor Zhou played along with a smile.
Behind Doctor Zhou, a resident doctor who looked so ordinary that other people had trouble remembering his name had the urge to whip out his notebook and note down what Doctor Zhou had just said.
He muttered, “He’s definitely a clever portrait artist.”
All the doctors around him nodded in unison.
Take a portrait artist who was drawing the portrait of a king who was missing a leg and an eye for an example.
Even if the portrait artist were to draw him as a king with two long and healthy legs, no matter how good the portrait looked, it would just be a lie.
But if you were to draw a portrait of the king hunting with one leg propped on a stone and one eye hidden behind the gun, it would be perfect.
When it came to Huo Congjun, if you were to praise him and say that he was able to silent and subdue everyone with his skills, it would not hide the fact that he was missing an eye.
It might even sound like mockery.
All the resident doctors made up their minds to learn the craft of flattery from Doctor Zhou in the future.
Ling Ran’s skills were too hard to learn, after all, and Doctor Zhou’s skills seemed like a more practical choice...
Huo Congjun was in a pretty good mood.
He satisfied his desire to boast in front of Doctor Zhou and the other doctors for a bit more.
When he was in the massive conference room just now, he had no choice but to sound humble so that he could make Ling Ran look better.
He had suppressed his desire to boast for a long while.
After boasting for a few minutes, Huo Congjun turned and looked at Doctor Zhou.
“Why are you still in the waiting room?
Aren’t there a lot of work in the hospital today?”
“I have given the emergency hotline a call.
I told them to send the patients who are not seriously ill to other hospitals such as Yun Hua Provincial Hospital.
Doctors from one and a half treatment groups are in the emergency room, and that’s enough.” Doctor Zhou paused for a moment and laughed.
“I asked them to transfer more patients to other departments, so even though all of them have things to do, they aren’t too busy.
They’re in a very good mood now.”
“Hmm, this is a good thing too.
We no longer need to take in so many headache and fever patients either.
Since we’re an Emergency Medical Center, we must make it a point to act like a ‘center’.” Huo Congjun agreed.
However, he looked at Doctor Zhou again and said, “But we have to try our best to treat all the patients that we’re capable of treating.
Don’t just simply transfer patients to other departments.
What should we do in the future if everyone gets too used to transferring patients to other departments?”
“Yes, you’re right.” When Doctor Zhou saw that Huo Congjun was no longer focusing on the fact that he was slacking instead of working in the hospital, he could not help but flash a smile.
In the operating theater, Ling Ran answered the questions that rang out from the intercom every now and then.
Ma Yanlin and Lu Wenbin who were acting as assistants could not help smiling.
They were pleased with themselves.
Many of the questions were what they have asked before.
Now, they already know the answers.
Since both of them were busy acting as assistants, they had no time to think about why only less renowned and junior doctors were asking questions.
But when they heard these doctors asking questions that they already knew the answers to, they felt happy because of various reasons.
“Hmm, let me check on things for a moment.” Ling Ran asked for a pair of scissors and snipped off the last surgical thread.
He then checked on everything from beginning to end.
The assistants immediately suppressed their feelings of happiness and checked on things along with Ling Ran.
As for Yu Yuan, who was giving an explanatory commentary in the visitation room, she stopped the question and answer session.
As she held the mic, she lowered her voice naturally.
“Doctor Ling is very careful when operating on patients, and after he completes the surgery, he has high standards when checking on things.
All the assistants would be anxious at this time...”
“What would Doctor Ling do if you guys fail to carry out the checking process well?” a doctor in the visitation room suddenly asked out of curiosity.
Aside from the junior doctors, many doctors whose eyelids were heavy from sleepiness also looked at her in curiosity.
Even though all surgeons scolded other people in the operating theater, everyone wanted to know how other surgeons did it.
Yu Yuan was also at a loss of words when she heard this question.
She thought carefully about it for a long while and said, “Usually, when we fail to spot a problem, Doctor Ling will jump in and assist.”
“How about punishment?” An elderly man could not stop himself from smiling from ear to ear.
“Does he spank his assistants’ buttocks?”
Yu Yuan shook his head a little.
“From what I can remember, Doctor Ling almost never punished anyone.
If someone does something wrong, he would point out the mistake.
And then, I guess the person who made the mistake would feel guilty and ashamed.”
“What on earth does this mean?” The elderly man did not understand what Yu Yuan was saying at all.
Yu Yuan looked at the person who spoke and could not help but smile.
“I guess it means that Doctor Ling just has this imposing aura about him that would make his subordinate take the initiative to work hard.”
The elderly man laughed out loud.
“I think all this talk about imposing auras is bullsh*t.
Let me tell you, it’s more normal for surgeons to have a hardened heart and speak vicious words.”
As he spoke, the elderly man rose and pressed the intercom button.
He said with a smile, “Doctor Ling.”
“Yes?” Ling Ran’s voice was steady.
He raised his head to look at the visitation room.
The elderly man saw Ling Ran’s sharp gaze as he looked downward, and the words he intended to say were immediately stuck in his throat.
“What was I trying to say again?”
Ling Ran was already done with the surgery.
He furrowed his eyebrows and reprimanded the elderly man.
“Those who are not involved in the field of medicine, don’t press the intercom button.”
The elderly man squirmed uneasily, and he just had to say, “I’m sorry, erm...”
Ling Ran gestured, and with a beep, the circulating nurse in the operating theater ended the conversation.

chapters.title: Chapter 930: Scalpel, Please
paragraphs: A business jet slid nimbly on the runway at Yun Hua Airport.
The appearance of the business jet was very ordinary. It was silvery-white and shiny as if its cover had just been removed.
Du Jiadong got off the plane slowly with his son’s help.
“Dad, watch your step.” His son frowned and looked up at the sun as if he was not satisfied with the weather.
Du Jiadong let out a low hum before he said, “Please take me to the hospital and go back. I don’t need people here. The company needs you.”

“Big brother is at the company. It will still be the same even if I don’t go back. Didn’t the elderlies say that it is best for the eldest son to become someone great in the business world and the youngest son to accompany the family?” He assisted his father since he was the youngest son, and he made some random remarks.
Du Jiadong did not even bother rolling his eyes. He just went along with the conversation and said, “Of course it’s good that you like to stay at home.”

The youngest son’s expression changed slightly, and he changed the subject forcibly. “I don’t even know if Junan is reliable or not, and they even forced us to travel here. This doctor sure likes to put on airs.”

Du Jiadong looked at his youngest son this time and said, “Remember. No one is obligated to serve you. It is fine regardless of whether the doctor in Yun Hua Hospital wants to take care of us or not. Since we have traveled all the way here, do not say that he’s putting on airs.”
“Tonca Group doesn’t have a lot of business in Changxi. If it does, they still need to come to our house to perform your check-up.” The youngest son was not willing to be obedient this time.

Du Jiadong shook his head. He wanted to say something, but he felt his feet become weak for a moment, so he put away the idea of educating his son. He just sighed in his heart. If he could have another three or four years, He could have toughened up his youngest son as well and open up branches for Tonca Group in the future so that the siblings would not be in conflict.

However, in the case of hepatic metastasis from gastric cancer, even if he found the best doctor and used the most suitable plan, he still might not get a ten percent chance of surviving for five years. After so many years of doing business, it was really difficult for Du Jiadong to believe in a probability of just ten percent. It would be better to just let his youngest son continue to be a second-generation good-for-nothing rich boy. Du Jiadong would already be pleased if he could just get some cash and stocks and become rather well-off in his life.
“Old Bo is here,” the youngest son whispered when he saw Hospital Director Bo and his group in front of him.
Du Jiadong hummed in acknowledgment and said softly, “Call him Hospital Director Bo. Be polite. Hospital Director Bo has been working around the clock for many days too.”
“He has been working around the clock and ended up recommending us to visit Yun Hua Hospital for treatment, and we have to come here on our own.”
“He recommended it, and we took the suggestion,” Du Jiadong said softly. “Intellectuals prefer a good reputation more than profit, so there’s nothing to lose if you speak kind words to them.”

The youngest son had heard those words so many times that he could only grunt gloomily. He could sense that his father had been nagging more than usual recently. Perhaps he wanted to let out all the things he never got to say in his last moments.
He was a little upset when he thought about it, but he gradually became calmer.
“Chairman Du, it must have been a long day for you,” Hospital Director Bo greeted him with his group in a hospitable manner.

Junan was a medical intermediary, but if it could serve people at Du Jiadong’s level, it could have considerably reached the peak of its business. Those who were richer and had better social status than Du Jiadong would definitely use Junan differently, if they ever wanted to, of course.
“Hospital Director Bo, you’re the one who must have had a long day,” Du Jiadong said politely, “Let’s head straight to the hospital.”
“Okay, I’ve made arrangements...” Hospital Director Bo quickly boasted his contributions before he pushed Lao Yongyong out to take over.
“Doctor Lao, you have also worked hard.” Du Jiadong nodded a little, but his expression was even more cordial.
It was not easy to still have someone to trust at his age.

“Oh, no. I didn’t have a hard time whatsoever. Mister Du, you came all the way here personally... However, Yun Hua Hospital’s development in hepatic metastasis from gastric cancer is indeed at the forefront of this country...” Lao Yongyong nodded enthusiastically at Du Jiadong. The reason he could serve in Tonca Group was due to the group chairman’s trust in him. Therefore, Lao Yongyong made a careful inspection before collecting Junan’s money.

Hospital Director Bo represented Junan Clinic in hopes to secure cooperation with the talented surgeon in his twenties, Ling Ran. He was thinking of relying on him for another two or three decades to promote Junan Clinic. Therefore, when he was about to land the deal with Ling Ran, he used the divine tool in his trade to make sure Ling Ran would agree to it.

Lao Yongyong believed himself to have maintained a certain degree of professional ethics. In any case, the last few candidates had their own strengths and weaknesses. It was also necessary to let Du Jiadong go through the list of candidates, investigate them, and make his own judgment.

Lao Yongyong got on the bus with Du Jiadong and said, “Specifically speaking, Doctor Ling Ran is really suited to perform your surgery. Before this, Elder Mei and Elder Wang’s hepatectomies were done by Ling Ran, and the end results were very good...”
Du Jiadong nodded slightly but said nothing about it.
Hospital Director Bo got in another car and exhaled softly.
For him, he had already won half the battle by being able to persuade Du Jiadong to come to Yun Hua Hospital.
In fact, if he was forced to choose, Hospital Director Bo was more willing to secure Ling Ran than Du Jiadong.

A long-term breadwinner was better than short-term income. Besides, in the unique industry that was medical treatment, the value of doctors was far greater than that of patients. As the doctors’ skills grow, their fame would grow, and their patients would... Well, even if the patient wanted to have another surgery, it would depend on whether he had anything left to remove.

Junan Clinic was able to stand this day because it also relied on their firm grasp of the doctors. The phrase seeking medical treatment applied not only to ancient times, but also to the lives of today’s people.
The group of people moved to the hospital slowly. Then, they made arrangements for an inspection.

At present, tertiary Grade A hospitals still tended to be conservative when it came to getting their inspection results. Even if Hospital Director Bo worked around the clock, Yun Hua Hospital would absolutely not relax in its inspections because such work involved medical responsibility. At most, it would just ask the VIP clinic to slightly accommodate some of Du Jiadong’s requests. In the afternoon, Zuo Cidian walked into a room. The moment he entered the room, he heard complaints.
“That chief surgeon didn’t come here to have a look at all. What kind of doctor is that...?”
Zuo Cidian was unable to stifle his laugh as he looked at the Hospital Director Bo, who came out to receive him.
Hospital Director Bo nodded with a smile and mouthed, “He’s a pampered one.”

Zuo Cidian nodded and entered without pretending that he did not hear anything. He replied directly, “Doctor Ling has read through Mister Du’s test report, and we are doing an analysis in our group. I’d like to introduce myself first. I’m Zuo Cidian from Ling Ran’s treatment group and Mister Du’s doctor in charge. You can come to me if you have any doubts related to the hospital.”

“And here I was wondering why an old man suddenly came here when they said that Ling Ran is a young doctor...” The youngest son had a spiteful tongue, but his tone softened a little when he saw how old Zuo Cidian was.
Du Jiadong nodded and said, “Doctor Zuo. How is my situation?”

“Doctor Ling was going to come here to talk about it, but he encountered an emergency surgery,” Zuo Cidian offered some comforting words before he went along the conversation. “However, after reading your report, Doctor Ling suggested that you should have the surgery as soon as possible. He’ll come by later for the consultation. Let’s talk about it in detail by then.”
Du Jiadong’s expression changed slightly, and after looking at Lao Yongyong, he slowly said, “Does Doctor Ling think he can perform this surgery?”
“Yes,” Zuo Cidian, who did not know how to read scans, repeated Ling Ran’s answer.

Du Jiadong said nothing. He was sixty-five years old this year. Although he looked strong on the outside, his body was no longer healthy. After he consulted several doctors for his hepatic metastasis from stomach cancer, they were quite vague about whether he should receive an operation or not. They mostly told him about the situation for various treatments and asked him to choose on his own.
Du Jiadong had only ever encountered two doctors who recommended surgery so firmly.
“Pour Doctor Zuo a cup of tea,” Du Jiadong said to his youngest son, briefly revealing his stance in the situation.
The few people in the room looked at each other and smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 931: Neanderthal
paragraphs: Ling Ran was indeed carrying out emergency surgery.

The patient was under general anesthesia. After his abdominal cavity was open, a small amount of fluid could be seen oozing out. There was a large amount of blood-like fluid oozing out around the spleen. Together with the fact that the spleen had adhered to the abdominal cavity, the patient’s abdominal cavity was practically a mess. It looked like a pot of almost dried-out hotpot.

If this were to happen more than two years ago, doctors from the General Surgery Department would have been called over, and the patient would have been quickly transferred to the General Surgery Department.

However, the chief surgeon today, Doctor Zhou, had other ideas. He called Ling Ran over, and when Ling Ran was standing before him, he immediately said, “Ling Ran, you’re capable of performing splenic surgery and surgery on patients with peritonitis, right? How about pancreatic surgery? Do you know how to do it?”
“I don’t know how to perform pancreatic surgery, and I have not operated on many patients with peritonitis either,” Ling Ran answered frankly.

He was capable of total splenectomy, and it was so easy for him that it felt just like a game. Peritonitis was not very hard to deal with either, and Ling Ran was still learning how to do that on his own. But pancreatic surgery was very hard, and he had never really done it up until now.

Doctor Zhou nodded when he heard that. As he washed his hands alongside Ling Ran, he said, “The patient has already done an abdominal as well as pelvic CT and was initially diagnosed with splenic rupture along with effusion around the spleen. There is also the possibility of peritonitis and pancreatic pseudocyst. Now, can you continue with the exploratory laparotomy and deal with his spleen? If you encounter a problem with the pancreas, I’ll call a doctor from the General Surgery Department over. If there’s no problem, there would be no need to trouble them.”
Ling Ran agreed without thinking much of it. In his opinion, even though this was a more complicated emergency surgery, he could deal with it with the skills he possessed.
Doctor Zhou breathed a sigh of relief. As of late, the relationship between the Emergency Medical Center and the General Surgery Department was not as good as it seemed on the surface.

Now that the Emergency Medical Center was becoming more and more renowned, they had been taking in a lot more patients who needed emergency surgery. That was because more patients from other counties, other areas, and even other cities had been seeking emergency surgery here. This was a natural progression as the Emergency Medical Center upsized and became more known to other people.

On the other hand, patients suffering from internal medicine diseases such as myocardial infarction and cerebral infarction would most probably choose to head to Yun Hua Provincial Hospital or the People’s Liberation Army General Hospital. This was because Huo Congjun mostly held authority in the field of emergency surgery, and the Emergency Medical Center was not really capable of dealing with that many internal medicine diseases. Besides, compared with emergency surgery, Huo Congjun was not really inclined toward developing the Emergency Medical Center so that it had the capacity to treat more internal medicine diseases.

Moreover, because Ling Ran’s treatment group had greatly increased the number of surgeries carried out, the ratio of patients receiving emergency surgery to patients with internal medicine disease in the Emergency Medical Center was huge. Naturally, they had breached the territory of the General Surgery Department.

The General Surgery Department was still relatively calm in the face of this situation, though. After all, they had so many surgeries and patients that the doctors in the department could barely handle all of them. It was to the point that it was becoming a burden. But this did not mean that they would sit idly by as the Emergency Medical Center breached their territory.

In the past, whenever doctors in the Emergency Center carried out appendectomy and operated on patients with intestinal obstruction, not only did the General Surgery Department not care, but they were also very happy about it.

Even after Ling Ran started carrying out liver surgery, the development of the General Surgery Department was not really affected. However, the Emergency Medical Center was threading a thin line when they started carrying out gastrointestinal surgeries. Take gastrectomy as an example. The General Surgery Department themselves needed to scramble for patients with the Digestive Surgery Department. Of course, they were not happy now that the Emergency Medical Center had joined in the fight. The only reason the two departments had not gotten into a conflict yet was that the Digestive Surgery Department never showed any objection and Huo Congjun was an oppressive person.

With the way that the Emergency Medical Center continued to increase in scale, though, the General Surgery Department’s attitude toward the matter had generally changed. If Doctor Zhou were to encounter such a patient in the past, he would have called a doctor over from the General Surgery Department without hesitation. However, he now had to put much more thought into it.

When it came to splenic surgeries, no one really knew which department held the jurisdiction. If the General Surgery Department were to take this opportunity to meddle with the patients in the Emergency Medical Center with spleen problems, Doctor Zhou would get into trouble.
He recalled the way Huo Congjun mercilessly scolded resident doctors. Doctor Zhou was once a resident doctor, and this memory was fresh in his mind.

“Since you’re capable of treating the patient’s spleen, we’ll handle this within our department. Nonetheless, this patient’s symptoms are kind of special, so you’ll have to pay extra attention to it.” Even though Doctor Zhou was concerned with office politics, he only talked about the patient’s symptoms with Ling Ran.
As long as the patient’s symptoms were alleviated, the problems related to office politics would be solved naturally. Doctor Zhou was confident in this.
Ling Ran was washing his hands, and he could feel the strength of the water that flowed out of the faucet. “What’s special about it?”

Doctor Zhou organized his thoughts and said, “Two months ago, the patient started experiencing upper left abdominal pain without known reasons. It is a continuous, distending pain, and it happens along with distending pain in the waist too. The pain is also relatively intense. After he went to consult a doctor in a county hospital, the doctor treated him by alleviating his symptoms, and he showed some improvements. However, not long after he was discharged, the pain happened again, and without any known reasons too. He then got admitted into a local hospital and received treatment that focused on the symptoms too. Even though the symptoms were once again alleviated, it came back soon after he was discharged, which is why he came to Yun Hua Hospital...”
“He wants further treatment? Shouldn’t he have gotten a slot in a specialized department instead...?”

“The patient took an ambulance over. He came too late and was unable to get any slot, so he came to the Emergency Department. We thought about transferring him to another department, but he went into circulatory collapse, perhaps because the journey was too tiring to him. So we had no choice but to send him for emergency surgery.” Doctor Zhou did not talk much about the patient not being able to get a number.

For top tertiary Grade A hospitals in an area like Yun Hua Hospital, a lot of patients brought slots from scalpers to see specialists. This was why a lot of patients started queueing up the day before for slots.

For patients like the one they were dealing with right then who had been experiencing continuous abdominal pain and could not get a slot at a short notice, he had no choice but to go to the Emergency Department.

This could be considered a technique used by patients to receive proper treatment. If there was really a need, after obtaining a place in the Emergency Department, the Emergency Department would transfer them to specialized departments. Even though it involved going through unnecessary procedures, they would at least get to receive adequate treatment. Correspondingly, patients who sought treatment using this method had no control over which department they would be transferred to. It was just like a student who allowed the government to place him in whatever university they wanted after he passed his college entrance examination.

After that patient was sent into the operating theater for emergency surgery, he would have even less control over who the surgeon was. Doctor Zhou did an exploratory laparotomy, and if the patient’s illness required general surgery, Doctor Zhou could call a doctor from the General Surgery Department over. He could also ask Ling Ran to do it or do it himself. However, if he found out that the patient suffered from an illness that required other kinds of surgery, he would have to call over doctors from other departments.

Ling Ran listened to Doctor Zhou as the latter explained the patient’s situation. After he wiped his hands dry, he tossed the towel into a pail. He crossed his hands before his chest and returned to the operating theater. He saw that Ren Qi who was acting as the assistant was aspirating the thick, blood-like fluid in a flustered manner.
“Are there fresh blood oozing out?” Ling Ran craned his head to look at the patient’s abdominal cavity.

“Yes, the situation inside the abdominal cavity is very complicated.” As a doctor who was there for in-service training, Ren Qi had seen many things and was considered very experienced. He could be said to be a well-rounded member of the Ling Treatment Group. If a person were to put it in more practical terms, he could compare Ren Qi to a blue-collar worker at the prime of his life. Even though that blue-collar worker was not exceptionally talented or skillful, because of his years of experience and hard work, he could be put into good use in various kinds of occasions.

He was not especially good at anything and was just an ordinary doctor. But he did really have any obvious flaw, and he rarely made any mistakes. Even when he made mistakes, they were mistakes that could be easily rectified. Hence, he had plenty of opportunities to participate in surgeries within the Ling Treatment Group.
Despite that, Ren Qi was mediocre when it came to observing the situation.

Doctor Zhou looked at the patient’s abdominal cavity and gently fiddled with the organs a little. “The problem right now is that the adhesion is too serious. His abdominal cavity has adhered to the abdominal wall, and the cauda of his pancreas is surrounded by the adhered structures. And the blood is probably oozing out from his spleen...”
Ling Ran hummed in acknowledgment and looked at the patient’s abdominal cavity too.

Exploratory laparotomy could be said to be the ultimate method to detect bugs in a patient’s abdominal cavity. Take the patient on the operating table as an example. Even though he had done many scans and examinations, the source of his symptoms could not be traced. But exploratory laparotomy showed that there was hemorrhage in his spleen and that there were many adhered structures in his abdominal cavity. A diagnosis was easily made.
“Seems like a chronic splenic rupture.” Doctor Zhou sighed and said, “With such serious adhesion, I’m afraid that we’ll have to remove his spleen along with the cauda of his pancreas.”
Ling Ran raised his head a little and said, “I’ve never done it before.”
“Alright... If you can’t do it, I’ll call someone from the General Surgery Department over...”
“I can separate the spleen and the cauda of the pancreas.” Ling Ran’s words gave Doctor Zhou a pleasant surprise.

Doctor Zhou immediately became elated, but he became a little hesitant soon after that. “Don’t force yourself. What if something wrong happens? It would be good enough if we can keep the rest of his pancreas...”

“I’ll give it a try.” Ling Ran did not promise anything either. The pancreas was renowned for being a very tender organ. If a person were to hold a pancreas, he would feel like he was holding a bag of oil. It was extremely difficult to separate the pancreas from other structures.
Doctor Zhou immediately felt at ease. He said with a smile, “It would be best if separation is possible...”
“Oh, by the way, tell Zuo Cidian that I’m doing this.” Ling Ran reminded Doctor Zhou. This surgery would definitely take more than one and a half hours.
Doctor Zhou hummed in acknowledgment and asked, “What’s Zuo Cidian up to?”
“Hospital Director Bo from Junan Clinic invited the director of Dongjia Group over. They’re probably going to arrive at the VIP patient building soon,” Ling Ran explained.
Doctor Zhou’s eyes almost shot out of his sockets. “Today?”
“Yeah. He sent me a message half an hour ago to say that they have landed.”
“They’re here today, I mean, now?” Doctor Zhou confirmed again.
Ling Ran nodded. “I’m going to get started with the separation.”
After he said that, he ignored Doctor Ling and started operating on the patient.
Doctor Zhou stood beside Ling Ran and muttered. ‘So, I’ve still gotten myself into trouble, haven’t I?’

It looked like a pot of almost dried-out hotpot.

chapters.title: Chapter 932: We’re Different
paragraphs: Du Chengji was standing in front of a pot of spider plant. His gaze was gloomy as he stared at the branches, and he sounded like he was reciting a poem as he said, “Such a beautiful plant, don’t you think so?”
The young nurse beside him covered her mouth as she smiled.

Du Chengji immediately became excited. He was familiar with this kind of smile. Whenever a woman smiled like this, she was thinking about how she would continue entertaining a man because he seemed rich.

Du Chengji took a deep breath and suppressed his desire to look at the nurse’s white uniform. He continued to look at the spider plant and expressed his emotions. “The plants are growing really well. The people taking care of the plants must have put plenty of effort into it. Aren’t everyone in hospitals nowadays really busy? Do you guys have time to water the plant and give it fertilizer? Or is it true that beautiful women just have to sprinkle a few drops of water on a plant for it to grow beautifully?”
The young nurse was still covering her mouth and smiling.

From the corner of his eyes, Du Chengji noticed that the young nurse’s smile had changed. She seemed to be thinking about how he was pretty interesting and was good at chatting. She was also thinking about how tremendously rich he was and hoping that he was a sincere person.

Du Chengji was pleased with himself. He extended his left hand to reveal his diamond-studded Vacheron Constantin wristwatch. The diamonds sparkled as he fiddled with the spider plant. He said with a smile, “I’ve been spending the last few years accompanying my dad, and I don’t even have time to go out and have fun anymore. I don’t participate in many social activities, and I’m not good at talking. So, please don’t be angry if I say something wrong. Erm, the leaves of this spider plant are really smooth.”
The young nurse was still covering her mouth and smiling.
Du Chengji hid his fingers underneath his diamond-studded Vacheron Constantin wristwatch and secretly pulled a leaf of the spider plant forcefully.
It did not budge.
Du Chengji finally shifted his attention away from the young nurse to the spider plant before him.
He squeezed and rubbed the leaf...

Du Chengji had done industrial research in Germany’s Humboldt University of Berlin; read books in Florence, Italy and thought about life in Avenue des Champs-Élysées, Paris. He was highly qualified and had read a lot of books. He was also an adept thinker. Now, he was putting those qualities to good use and made a judgment.
‘This plant is made of plastic!’

Du Chengji took another deep breath, and he could not help but become furious. ‘It costs 1,200 RMB a day to stay in a ward in the VIP patient building. Who the heck would have expected that the spider plants in the corridors are fake? Prostitutes who cost 1,200 RMB a night put fresh flowers in their homes every two days, okay?’
Du Chengji turned his head a little to look at the young nurse in the face. He decided to make the ultimate move.
He gazed at the young nurse. His voice was rich in emotion and sincerity as he said, “This watch of mine is Vacheron Constantin, from the Traditionnelle collection.”
The young nurse looked at Du Chengji with a smile on his face.

Du Chengji used a firmer tone as he said, “I purchased this Vacheron Constantin watch when I’ve just worked for a year. I bought it with the money I earned with my own hands. Even though it’s one of the more ordinary models from the Traditionnelle collection, personally, I really like it. I’m saying this to prove a point that I’m not a rich man’s son who only knows how to spend money.”
Du Chengji quietly waited for five seconds, but he did not get any response. He sighed and turned to leave without looking back.
“A**hole,” another young nurse’s voice rang out from behind him. She had been watching Du Chengji’s interaction with the young nurse, and she was obviously a toxic friend.
“One who only knows how to toy with girls,” a third nurse commented.
Du Chengji suppressed the desire to turn and continued walking forward.
If he walked away fast enough, they would not be able to catch up with him and scold him as a group. That was the biggest lesson Du Chengji had learned during his three years of studying overseas.
The young nurses in the corridor let their mouths run even more freely.
One of the young nurse’s toxic friends said, “It’s Vacheron Constantin. Are you really not going to give him a try?”
“He’s too ugly,” the young nurse who had been covering her mouth and smiling earlier answered firmly.
“But he’s wearing a Vacheron Constantin wristwatch. Vacheron Constantin!”
“But it’s not like he’s going to give me a Vacheron Constantin watch, is he? Plus, he has such an ugly face.”
“You know what? You’re right.”
“Makes sense!”
Du Chengji who was walking at the end of the corridor could still hear the young nurses’ muffled voices, but he would rather have not heard it.
*Pit pat pit pat*

Outside the window, rain suddenly started falling. The raindrops fell on the glass windows of the VIP patient building, producing loud and clear sounds akin to the sound made when a drop of water fell onto the butt of a porcelain doll.
Du Chengji was in low spirits as he returned to the ward.
He was able to get used to failure, but the plastic spider plant lingered in his mind.
In the ward, two doctors who were obviously leaders were talking to Du Jiadong. Du Chengji lost interest after glancing at them a few times.
They were not the director of Yun Hua Hospital, and they were not being very humble either.

Du Chengji could not help but think about how if they were at the territory of Tonca Group, no matter which tertiary Grade A hospital his father stayed in, everyone in the hospital would roll out the red carpet for him. Unfortunately, the hospitals in the territory of Tonca Group were not good at the postoperative care of gastric cancer, let alone gastrectomy in combination with hepatic resection. It was to the point that his father suffered from liver metastasis only one year after he received surgery...

Du Chengji could not help but start to understand why rich people were always donating to medical organizations. If he ended up inheriting his family wealth of several billion RMB, he would donate some of the money to medical organizations...
*Knock knock*
Someone was knocking on the door. A hospital leader who was sitting by the bedside cleared his throat and said, “This should be Doctor Ling.”
“Young Ji, go and open the door,” Du Jiadong ordered him softly.

Du Chengji immediately panicked when his father called him by his pet name. He quickly rose and opened the door. He was grumbling internally. ‘He could have asked two beautiful young girls to do this...’
The moment Du Chengji opened the door, his mind went blank. ‘What have I just seen?’

“Doctor Ling, come on in.” Associate Hospital Director Zhou was used to such situations. She waved to Ling Ran. She then turned toward Du Jiadong and said, “Doctor Ling encountered a patient whose organs in the abdominal cavity were adhered together, and the patient’s condition was very serious. His spleen was ruptured. Hence, Ling Ran was the only one who could operate on him.”
Hospital Director Zhou was exaggerating things a little, but given the situation right now, Du Jiadong could not help but nod a few times in approval.

“Doctor Ling is the best in our hospital when it comes to combined liver and pancreatic radical surgery.” Department Director Lei from the Medical Affairs Department was also there. There was a gentle smile on his face, and he looked completely different from the times he would viciously scold medical interns.

Of course, even though he was not exactly telling the truth, it was not a false statement either. Scarcely any doctor in Yun Hua Hospital knew how to perform combined liver and pancreatic radical surgery, so being the best meant nothing.
But it meant something to Du Jiadong, so that would do.
“Ling Ran, meet Chairman Du.” There was a kindly smile on Associate Hospital Director Zhou’s face as she introduced Du Jiadong to Ling Ran.
“Please, just call me Old Du,” Du Jiadong said politely.
Ling Ran merely nodded. He scrutinized Du Jiadong carefully and said, “I’ll perform a physical examination for you.”
As he spoke, Ling Ran gestured at Du Jiadong to lie on his back.

Du Jiadong was the chairman of a company worth tens of billions of RMB. Complying with Ling Ran’s request, he pulled his blanket aside and lay on his back. He then lifted his shirt up and revealed his belly. There were goosebumps on his skin because of the cold, and he was shivering a little, but there was nothing he could do about it.
Ling Ran carried out a detailed physical examination step by step. Whenever he encountered something he was unsure of, he activated the Virtual Human and quickly dissected it to take a look.
To Du Jiadong and the other people, Ling Ran looked like he was lost in his own world as he waved his hands around in a strange manner.
Due to how handsome he looked, however, no one had the heart to stop him.

Du Jiadong was lying on his back in the hospital bed, and he noticed that Ling Ran appeared and acted totally differently compared with other doctors, and that slowly put his mind at ease. ‘For someone who’s as sick as me, perhaps a peculiar doctor is needed.’
