chapters.title: Chapter 947: Tiger Chasing After a Rabbit
paragraphs: How did it feel like to insert a needle into cardiac tissue?
Ling Ran did not have the chance to focus on the sensation immediately.

This was his first time carrying out cardiac trauma repair and the first time he was operating on a patient’s heart. There were way too many things that he needed to focus on, and there was no time for him to dwell in his emotions.
The only person who was dwelling in his emotions was Department Director Kang.

He was watching someone else perform cardiac trauma repair, which was what he was best at, skillfully. Even though it was the simplest cardiovascular surgery out of many, to surgeons, cardiovascular surgery used to be a forbidden zone. Department Director Kang could not help but feel as though someone else had touched something that belonged to him. He was furious, embarrassed, thrilled, guilty, and emotional at the same time.
However, no one cared about what was on his mind. The surgery continued on as usual.

Ling Ran extended a slender finger and gently pressed it on the cardiac wound. His movement was so controlled and gentle that he looked like a man in one of those television dramas who was gently pressing a finger on the female lead’s lips.
The young nurses in the operating theater could not help but squeal internally.
The patient’s heart seemed to quiver a little too, and it was as if it was about to go into atrial fibrillation.
Ling Ran’s finger was stable, and he exerted an even amount of strength.

If a surgeon’s finger was not stable enough, or if the surgeon did not exert an even amount of strength, the cardiac wound would treat the surgeon like how female leads in television dramas treated the male leads. They would shove the male lead away all of a sudden and run away, and that would be the cornerstone of the plot development for the next twenty episodes.
However, if pressure was properly applied on the wound, a 10-0 polypropylene surgical thread would be able to tame the heart with the help of a needle.
Everyone could not help but focus on the surgical field.

They watched as Ling Ran inserted the needle into where his finger was and pierced through every single layer of cardiac tissue. It was as if they were watching with bated breath as a television drama suddenly turned into an artistic film.
As Ling Ran inserted the needle, Faulkner was tremendously focused on the surgical field too.
The slightly drunk American doctor was ready to stop Ling Ran at any moment and clear up whatever mess that might arise.
Even though he was merely an ordinary doctor in Mayo Clinic, he was capable of clearing up messes made by junior doctors.
Ling Ran skillfully pulled out the needle before it could pierce through the endocardium.
Faulkner immediately felt ease. A surgeon who was so skillful at suturing could definitely handle all the maneuvers involved in cardiac trauma repair well.
Without hesitation, Faulkner went forward and helped Ling Ran to make a knot. He also checked that both sides of the tear were aligned.
After some time, Faulkner was done, but before he could say anything, Ling Ran had already slid his finger downwards, revealing another part of the tear.
He sutured the part of the tear he had just revealed, and a knot was made. He also ensured that both sides of the tear were aligned...
After repeating the same process thrice, the considerably large tear was sutured.
At the same time, Faulkner realized that he seemed to be playing the role of an assistant again from the beginning to the end...
“Yes, it’s pretty well done,” Faulkner praised Ling Ran, and he tried his best to show that he was still superior to Ling Ran through his tone.
Ling Ran flashed a socially appropriate smile and said, “I feel pretty good too.”
“Hmm... since the surgery was done so well, it’s only natural that you’re feeling good.” There was a hint of jealousy in Faulkner’s voice.

He desired to carry out the surgery. This was especially true because he had just experienced a tremendously boring party, and a simple cardiovascular surgery where he could vent out all his frustrations was exactly what he needed.

“Alright, let’s close the patient’s thoracic cavity.” Faulkner did not intend to let another person finish up the surgery. If the surgery were a dinner party, the suturing of the cardiac wound would be the main course. Since Faulkner did not get to taste the main course, he wanted to make do with some side dishes. It was better than not eating anything.
Ling Ran nodded a little, and he started stitching up the patient’s thoracic cavity without saying a thing.

Due to the highly dangerous nature of cardiovascular surgeries, the final segments of cardiovascular surgeries were slightly more important than the final segments of other surgeries. As doctors always said, “If a mistake is made during surgery, the patient will not have a chance to leave the operating theater alive. And if the finer details of the surgery are not done well, it will be hard for the doctors in the ICU to take care of the patient. Without good postoperative care, things would be difficult for the patient after he gets discharged...”
It was Ling Ran’s very first cardiovascular surgery, and he was involved in it from the beginning to the end.
The moment he put down a pair of scissors, a notification from the system appeared.
[Mission Completed: Give Cardiac Trauma Repair a try]
[Mission Details: Participate in cardiac trauma repair and feel how fun it is to carry out a cardiovascular surgery]
[Mission Reward: Energy Serum]
A bottle of Energy Serum appeared before Ling Ran. It was sparkling.
Ling Ran waved in dismissal and put the bottle of Energy Serum in his inventory. He looked like how he did whenever he encountered brilliant but not extraordinary classmates back in university.

That was when Huo Congjun walked over to the operating table. Doctor Zhou was behind Huo Congjun, and he was holding a phone. Huo Congjun sounded like an old and ugly reporter as he asked, “Doctor Faulkner, what do you feel about the very first cardiovascular Doctor Ling performed?”

“He did very well, extremely well.” Now that Faulkner was being “filmed”, he naturally started to exaggerate things, which was typical of an American. “It was better than what I had anticipated. It was definitely at a professional level.”

As he spoke, he started recalling the surgery just now, and he slowly started to appreciate it from the bottom of his heart. Right now, he seemed to think that he had not been earnest enough earlier, and there was sincerity in his voice. “Doctor Ling is extremely skilled, and he is probably quite talented in cardiovascular surgeries. He shouldn’t waste this God-given gift.”
Before Ling Ran could say anything, Huo Congjun started nodding vigorously. “You’re right. Ling Ran needs a good platform for him to be able to showcase his skills...”

The face of the department director of the Cardiovascular Surgery Department was starting to turn pale. The Cardiovascular Surgery Department was tiny, and it was definitely no match for the Emergency Department, which had been elevated to the status of Emergency Medical Center. If He Yuanzheng’s Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery was considered a small department in Yun Hua Hospital, the Cardiovascular Surgery Department was undoubtedly a marginalized department. At least, the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery carried out almost a thousand surgeries a year, and they were responsible for their own finances. The Cardiovascular Surgery Department existed for no reason other than to support Yun Hua Hospital’s status as a general hospital...
“Department Director Huo... about this... don’t...” Department Director Kang wanted to speak like someone who was experiencing a mental breakdown, but his words were stuck in his throat.

Huo Congjun ignored Department Director Kang altogether. Being at a strategically advantageous position, he said, “With how things are going in Yun Hua Hospital right now, what we need to do next is to bring the schedule of merging the ICU with us forward.”
“Huh?” Department Director Kang could not help but freeze. Could it be that... when this tiger was chasing after a rabbit, it came across a goat?

Huo Congjun turned and said to Ling Ran, “I’ve actually been thinking about the matter concerning the ICU lately. Hepatectomy is already difficult enough in itself, let alone gastrectomy in combination with hepatic resection. An ICU is very important to us.”

Department Director Kang nodded vigorously. ‘Go ahead and oppress the ICU. I’ve been annoyed at the ICU for a long time anyway. They’re always bullying department directors of small departments like mine.”

Huo Congjun was also in the process of convincing himself. He nodded a few times and said, “Ling Ran, go ahead if you want to perform cardiovascular surgeries. I’ve talked to the people in charge of the ICU quite a few times, and we should be coming to a decision soon.”
Ling Ran hummed in acknowledgment and said, “There doesn’t seem to be many patients here who require cardiovascular surgeries.”

“It’s alright. Just operate on the patients that you manage to get your hands on. I’ll think about what we can do next.” Huo Congjun seemed confident. He did not seem concerned that there were not enough patients.
Department Director Kang, though, could not help but become absentminded. As he looked at Ling Ran, he became so jealous that he was about to go into atrial fibrillation.

sentences.text: How did it feel like to insert a needle into cardiac tissue?
Ling Ran did not have the chance to focus on the sensation immediately.
This was his first time carrying out cardiac trauma repair and the first time he was operating on a patient’s heart.
There were way too many things that he needed to focus on, and there was no time for him to dwell in his emotions.
The only person who was dwelling in his emotions was Department Director Kang.
He was watching someone else perform cardiac trauma repair, which was what he was best at, skillfully.
Even though it was the simplest cardiovascular surgery out of many, to surgeons, cardiovascular surgery used to be a forbidden zone.
Department Director Kang could not help but feel as though someone else had touched something that belonged to him.
He was furious, embarrassed, thrilled, guilty, and emotional at the same time.
However, no one cared about what was on his mind.
The surgery continued on as usual.
Ling Ran extended a slender finger and gently pressed it on the cardiac wound.
His movement was so controlled and gentle that he looked like a man in one of those television dramas who was gently pressing a finger on the female lead’s lips.
The young nurses in the operating theater could not help but squeal internally.
The patient’s heart seemed to quiver a little too, and it was as if it was about to go into atrial fibrillation.
Ling Ran’s finger was stable, and he exerted an even amount of strength.

If a surgeon’s finger was not stable enough, or if the surgeon did not exert an even amount of strength, the cardiac wound would treat the surgeon like how female leads in television dramas treated the male leads.
They would shove the male lead away all of a sudden and run away, and that would be the cornerstone of the plot development for the next twenty episodes.
However, if pressure was properly applied on the wound, a 10-0 polypropylene surgical thread would be able to tame the heart with the help of a needle.
Everyone could not help but focus on the surgical field.
They watched as Ling Ran inserted the needle into where his finger was and pierced through every single layer of cardiac tissue.
It was as if they were watching with bated breath as a television drama suddenly turned into an artistic film.
As Ling Ran inserted the needle, Faulkner was tremendously focused on the surgical field too.
The slightly drunk American doctor was ready to stop Ling Ran at any moment and clear up whatever mess that might arise.
Even though he was merely an ordinary doctor in Mayo Clinic, he was capable of clearing up messes made by junior doctors.
Ling Ran skillfully pulled out the needle before it could pierce through the endocardium.
Faulkner immediately felt ease.
A surgeon who was so skillful at suturing could definitely handle all the maneuvers involved in cardiac trauma repair well.
Without hesitation, Faulkner went forward and helped Ling Ran to make a knot.
He also checked that both sides of the tear were aligned.
After some time, Faulkner was done, but before he could say anything, Ling Ran had already slid his finger downwards, revealing another part of the tear.
He sutured the part of the tear he had just revealed, and a knot was made.
He also ensured that both sides of the tear were aligned...
After repeating the same process thrice, the considerably large tear was sutured.
At the same time, Faulkner realized that he seemed to be playing the role of an assistant again from the beginning to the end...
“Yes, it’s pretty well done,” Faulkner praised Ling Ran, and he tried his best to show that he was still superior to Ling Ran through his tone.
Ling Ran flashed a socially appropriate smile and said, “I feel pretty good too.”
“Hmm... since the surgery was done so well, it’s only natural that you’re feeling good.” There was a hint of jealousy in Faulkner’s voice.
He desired to carry out the surgery.
This was especially true because he had just experienced a tremendously boring party, and a simple cardiovascular surgery where he could vent out all his frustrations was exactly what he needed.
“Alright, let’s close the patient’s thoracic cavity.” Faulkner did not intend to let another person finish up the surgery.
If the surgery were a dinner party, the suturing of the cardiac wound would be the main course.
Since Faulkner did not get to taste the main course, he wanted to make do with some side dishes.
It was better than not eating anything.
Ling Ran nodded a little, and he started stitching up the patient’s thoracic cavity without saying a thing.
Due to the highly dangerous nature of cardiovascular surgeries, the final segments of cardiovascular surgeries were slightly more important than the final segments of other surgeries.
As doctors always said, “If a mistake is made during surgery, the patient will not have a chance to leave the operating theater alive.
And if the finer details of the surgery are not done well, it will be hard for the doctors in the ICU to take care of the patient.
Without good postoperative care, things would be difficult for the patient after he gets discharged...”
It was Ling Ran’s very first cardiovascular surgery, and he was involved in it from the beginning to the end.
The moment he put down a pair of scissors, a notification from the system appeared.
[Mission Completed: Give Cardiac Trauma Repair a try]
[Mission Details: Participate in cardiac trauma repair and feel how fun it is to carry out a cardiovascular surgery]
[Mission Reward: Energy Serum]
A bottle of Energy Serum appeared before Ling Ran.
It was sparkling.
Ling Ran waved in dismissal and put the bottle of Energy Serum in his inventory.
He looked like how he did whenever he encountered brilliant but not extraordinary classmates back in university.
That was when Huo Congjun walked over to the operating table.
Doctor Zhou was behind Huo Congjun, and he was holding a phone.
Huo Congjun sounded like an old and ugly reporter as he asked, “Doctor Faulkner, what do you feel about the very first cardiovascular Doctor Ling performed?”
“He did very well, extremely well.” Now that Faulkner was being “filmed”, he naturally started to exaggerate things, which was typical of an American.
“It was better than what I had anticipated.
It was definitely at a professional level.”
As he spoke, he started recalling the surgery just now, and he slowly started to appreciate it from the bottom of his heart.
Right now, he seemed to think that he had not been earnest enough earlier, and there was sincerity in his voice.
“Doctor Ling is extremely skilled, and he is probably quite talented in cardiovascular surgeries.
He shouldn’t waste this God-given gift.”
Before Ling Ran could say anything, Huo Congjun started nodding vigorously.
“You’re right.
Ling Ran needs a good platform for him to be able to showcase his skills...”
The face of the department director of the Cardiovascular Surgery Department was starting to turn pale.
The Cardiovascular Surgery Department was tiny, and it was definitely no match for the Emergency Department, which had been elevated to the status of Emergency Medical Center.

If He Yuanzheng’s Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery was considered a small department in Yun Hua Hospital, the Cardiovascular Surgery Department was undoubtedly a marginalized department.
At least, the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery carried out almost a thousand surgeries a year, and they were responsible for their own finances.
The Cardiovascular Surgery Department existed for no reason other than to support Yun Hua Hospital’s status as a general hospital...
“Department Director Huo... about this... don’t...” Department Director Kang wanted to speak like someone who was experiencing a mental breakdown, but his words were stuck in his throat.
Huo Congjun ignored Department Director Kang altogether.

chapters.title: Chapter 948: Classical Conditioning
paragraphs: In the afternoon, Lu Wenbin returned with Ling Ran after their ward round in the ICU, and he saw several engineers in uniform making measurements at the nurse’s desk.
“What’s going on?” Lu Wenbin curiously cast a glance before he took the opportunity to lean on the nurse’s desk to look around.
“We’re getting a bigger ward, or so they say.” The young nurse who stayed at the nurse’s desk today was a junior nurse who had just joined recently. Her voice was soft and sweet as she talked calmly.
Lu Wenbin’s heart raced.
‘Her voice is so good! It’s really good!’
Lu Wenbin felt a tug on the tendon in his heart, which had not been tugged for a long time.

Lu Wenbin looked at the young nurse’s face again. Her skin was fair and clean. There was a beauty mole on her right cheek. Where exactly should a beauty mole be, you ask? Lu Wenbin did not know, and he did not care. In other words, to him, a beauty mole was just a mole on a beauty.
“I haven’t seen you around before,” Lu Wenbin greeted her with a smile.
The twenty-four-year-old senior nurse at the nurse station chuckled when she heard Lu Wenbin’s words. “Doctor Lu, I think I’ve heard that conversation starter before.”

“Conversation starter, huh? Conversation starters are just like surgical drapes, it doesn’t matter if it’s a little off the center.” Lu Wenbin was quite the glib speaker. He could already go up against an ordinary senior nurse in a verbal match.
An old, ordinary, senior nurse who sat in a small room sorting medicine snorted before saying, “Young Ma, be careful of Lu Wenbin. Money makes a man bad.”
Young Nurse Ma chuckled. “You’re a rich man’s son, Doctor Lu?”
“A rich man’s son? Why? Do I look like one?” Lu Wenbin looked up proudly.
“It’s because you look rather young.” Young Nurse Ma smiled. Her voice sounded as sweet as always.
“Well, being young and rich is my fault.” Lu Wenbin felt his heart flutter as he listened to the nurse’s voice.
However, he never concealed the fact that he made pork trotters.
There was no need to hide this fact during the early stage of his business, and even now, there was still no need for him to hide it.
He was Ling Ran’s team member. As long as Department Director Huo did not say anything, no one could do anything about him.

Lu Wenbin was not afraid of anyone bullying him in private either. He was now the second-best doctor in Ling Ran’s treatment group when it came to the M-Tang technique. With this skill, as long as he was not working for money, it would be easy for him to just be a doctor.

Present hospitals might not care about money, but they had to care about their doctors. Of course, doctors who could complete difficult surgeries independently were the apple of the hospital’s eyes. Meanwhile, doctors who could not work independently were nothing more than a person.

According to Lu Wenbin’s current resume, he had plenty of reasons to be hired by other tertiary Grade A hospitals. It may be difficult for him to change to a hospital that was also considered a top dog in another region, but he could easily go to another normal tertiary Grade A hospital.
Young Nurse Ma cast Lu Wenbin a profound glance and smiled again. “Let me guess, is the pork trotter business in the hospital yours?”

No matter how large a department in a hospital was, it would only have around one hundred people, and most of them were nurses. For example, Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center was already very huge, but there were only five treatment groups with about thirty doctors, including those housemen who were authorized but were still wandering around from department to department. The new, young nurses could learn about the doctors easily without even go around asking for information.

Lu Wenbin coughed a couple of times before he modestly said, “It was just pure, plain coincidence for me, but it’s mainly because I mastered this skill, and now, everyone is taking care of my business.”
“Then, you must remember to get a business license.”
“Yes, I did it a long time ago. I even have a sanitary certificate. I take this business seriously.”
“But aren’t you a civil servant? Wouldn’t it affect you?”
Lu Wenbin shook his head. “I put this business under my mother’s name.”
“Oh, that’s convenient,” the young nurse said. She lowered her head and began to sort out the hospital forms and other things, which she had just received.
Lu Wenbin was instantly a little dumbfounded. ‘Is this the end of the conversation? Did I say the wrong thing? Does she like me more or less?’

Lu Wenbin did not have the ability to restart the conversation. It was because others had said that about him before: Lu Wenbin had actually practiced his really weak conversation starter and became familiar with it before he could blurt it out with ease.
Unfortunately, he became too familiar with that conversation starter, causing him to use it too frequently...
“I’ll be heading off for surgeries now.” Lu Wenbin hesitated for a few seconds. He did not know what to do, so he had to say his goodbye and head to the operating theater gloomily.
After all, the nurse with the good voice was already there, and she could not go anywhere else. The operating theater was actually more exciting as well.
Lu Wenbin walked faster and faster. He let out a sigh of relief when he reached the dressing room with the green tiles.

Operating theaters were still better. The colors used to decorate the place were pleasant to the eye, and it was not blinding. The temperature was also suitable, and it would not make people sweat. The interpersonal relationship among people was even more perfect. There were plenty of times where even if you poked a hole in someone with a scalpel and blood spilled everywhere, people would not say a word.
“Doctor Lu, you’re here.” Zhang Anmin also reached the operating theater after finishing his ward round.

After he was promoted to an associate chief physician, the number of beds he managed increased significantly. Even so, he could not cut down on the number of surgeries he performed. Moreover, since Ling Ran delegated power to his team members and the doctors under him such as Zhang Anmin and Lu Wenbin improved their skills, they gained a lot of chances to become chief surgeons.
Zhang Anmin was the chief surgeon for today’s surgery, and Lu Wenbin was the first assistant.

Zhang Anmin was in a good mood when he saw Lu Wenbin arrive early. “Doctor Lu, today’s cholecystitis patient is the principal of an elementary school. After the surgery, you may be acquainted with him. If there comes a day where you have to send your kid to school, you can go to him.”
“I’m afraid that by the time my son is born, the principal would have retired.” Lu Wenbin was not in a good mood. He spoke a little aggressively.

Zhang Anmin smiled in an unbothered fashion. “Even if he retires, there will be someone to take over his position. Anyway, as long as he doesn’t die of illness, we can say that we have done our duty.”
Lu Wenbin smiled. “Cholecystitis is not fatal.”
“Don’t jinx others.” Zhang Anmin put on airs. “Listen to me, if you’re unskilled, any patient will end up dying because of complications.”
Lu Wenbin was amused by Zhang Anmin. “Can’t the patient die on the operating table?”
“If you seriously suck, you wouldn’t be able to kill a man cleanly even after half a day is gone. Come on, let’s stop with the nonsense. It’s time to disinfect his belly. Let’s start.”
Lu Wenbin grunted gloomily.
Zhang Anmin quirked an eyebrow. “Bad mood?”
Lu Wenbin shrugged. “I don’t even have a chance to be in a bad mood. Sigh, my EQ is too low, and I can’t do anything about it.”
“So something did happen.” No matter what, Zhang Anmin was an experienced man. After observing Lu Wenbin closely, he nodded and asked, “Are you lovesick? Want to learn some tricks from this old man?”
“What tricks do you have?” Lu Wenbin looked at Zhang Anmin contemptuously and said, “Your EQ isn’t much higher than mine...”
“But when I got married, I was poorer than you. I had a bleak future, and I was not as fit as you.” Zhang Anmin stopped talking for a moment before he said, “Even so, I have a wife.”
Lu Wenbin was stunned. After a few seconds, he obediently asked, “What tricks?”
Zhang Anmin took a deep breath before he exhaled and solemnly said, “Have you heard of Pavlov’s Dating Method before?”
“Pavlov?”

Zhang Anmin nodded slowly. “Every day, he rang the bell at a fixed time before he fed his dog. Then, he managed to make the dog form a conditioned reflex. Even if there is no food in front of it, as long as it hears the bell ring, it will salivate.”
“But I don’t want to see women salivate.”
Zhang Anmin laughed out loud. “You do, trust me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 949: Loophole
paragraphs: [Young Ma, I’ve put the pork trotter in the refrigerator. I wrote your name on it.] Lu Wenbin slowly composed a message on WeChat.

Lu Wenbin had put in great effort to obtain Nurse Young Ma’s WeChat ID. If a person were to quantify it, the effort he put in was equivalent to giving every single experienced nurse in the department sixteen to eighteen pork trotters.

Of course, Lu Wenbin’s career was progressing well, so he did not care about this. If it were not for the fact that he was worried that his reputation would be destroyed, he would not even mind giving everyone in the department free pork trotters. It would not cost much to him anyway.
The only worry Lu Wenbin had now was regarding his love life.

He could not just spend all his energy in the gym every day. Of course, it was aesthetically pleasing to have a rock-hard chest and a firm a**. But there was no one around to look at his body, anyway, and he felt that all his effort to bulk up was for naught. The stinky men in the weightlifting area of the gym did not count.
*Beep*
A notification rang out from Lu Wenbin’s phone. He picked up his phone and saw a WeChat message from Young Ma.
[Did you keep the pork trotter in a lunch box? What does it look like? I don’t see any lunch box with my name on it.]

Lu Wenbin chuckled softly and loosened his grip on the stress ball he was holding. He started typing with great effort. [I wrote your name on the pork trotter itself. The label isn’t on the lunch box. Try to look for it. There should be a box of pork trotter in the refrigerator.]
For a while, Young Ma did not reply to his message.
Lu Wenbin chuckled. He was pleased with himself. ‘Are you astonished? Are you touched by my gesture? Are you euphoric now?’
Even though it was a little difficult to engrave two Chinese characters on a pork trotter, Lu Wenbin found a way to do it.

Lu Wenbin was forced to suppress his laughter. He wished that there was a scale where he could see how much Young Ma liked him. She had to like him a lot more now that he had engraved her name on a pork trotter.
“Doctor Lu, a patient with cardiac trauma is sent in.” Wang Jia, the nurse quickly walked over and reminded Lu Wenbin.

Lu Wenbin had been Ling Ran’s assistant for quite some time, and he could be said to be an all-rounder. He was capable of assisting in any type of surgery. Now that they were planning to start performing cardiovascular surgeries since Ling Ran did not have any assistants who were familiar with such surgeries, he naturally enlisted Lu Wenbin’s help.
Similarly, Wang Jia was often chosen to participate in surgeries whenever the treatment group first launched a surgical method.
Lu Wenbin immediately hummed in acknowledgment and asked, “Is it a perforation wound like the patient the other day?”
“It should be,” Wang Jia said and added, “There should be people watching the surgery today. Do take note.”
“Which level are those leaders from?” Lu Wenbin did not look like he was too concerned.

Ever since a visitation room was added to Operating Theater 1, plenty of doctors and leaders came to watch Ling Ran’s surgeries, and the doctors of the Ling Treatment Group were pretty much used to it.

Moreover, unlike ordinary surgeons, Ling Ran did not like to chit-chat and tell jokes during surgeries. It could be said that even on ordinary days, members of the Ling Treatment Group talked a lot less compared to members of other groups during surgeries. Because they did not have to worry about saying the wrong thing, they did not have to make extra effort to be presentable whenever other doctors or hospital leaders were invigilating or visiting.

Wang Jia was merely giving Lu Wenbin a friendly reminder. She replied, “Department Director Huo should be coming, and Associate Hospital Director Zhou might be here too. I don’t know about other leaders. Now that the foreigner is gone, Doctor Ling would have to carry out the cardiovascular surgery without supervision. So, the hospitals’ leaders would probably want to take a look at what’s going on.”

“Oh. It’ll be fine, then... What’s there to worry about when Doctor Ling is the chief surgeon? Wasn’t Doctor Ling the one doing all the work even when the foreigner was around?” Lu Wenbin paused for a moment and continued, “Wang Jia, erm... do you think that I should apply Pavlovian conditioning?”

The doctors and nurses of the treatment group had to see one another seven or eight hours a day. It was like they were in the same jail cell. They talked so much that they ran out of topics of conversation.
Hence, whenever a doctor in the treatment group had something interesting going on in his life, he would not be able to resist the urge to talk about it.
Everyone in the circle knew about how Lu Wenbin had been courting girls via Pavlov’s Dating Method.
Wang Jia had never been one to comment on Lu Wenbin’s method. However, she asked in astonishment, “You have not started using it yet?”

“It’s not that bad. Ah, let’s end this conversation. The patient’s almost here. I’ll go and take a look.” Suddenly, Lu Wenbin felt that he had a low IQ.
He fled to the ground floor and quietly sat on the chair to wait for the ambulance to send the patient with cardiac trauma over.

It was normal for there to be a couple of dozens of patients with cardiac trauma every year in a city like Yun Hua City. Most patients who were able to survive the trip to the hospital were probably able to survive the surgery.

“Department Director Kang? Why are you here?” Lu Wenbin answered his question with another question.

“Do you intend to do so?” Lu Wenbin asked in a soft voice.

Department Director Kang immediately became so infuriated that he was unable to speak. If it were not for the fact that he would not win in a fight against the Emergency Medical Center, he would have snatched the patient away right then in front of Lu Wenbin. ‘How dare he harbor doubts toward me!?’
“The patient’s here,” a nurse reminded Lu Wenbin. The siren of the ambulance could then be heard.
Department Director Kang looked at Lu Wenbin and his entourage with an envious expression on his face. He said nothing.

The Cardiovascular Surgery Department of Yun Hua Hospital did not use to get many patients with cardiac trauma in the past. Since the Emergency Department was not capable of performing cardiac trauma repair, they did not have much desire to take in patients with cardiac trauma.
It had been quite a while since Department Director Kang waited for an ambulance at the Emergency Department.
“Make way, make way.” After receiving the patient, Lu Wenbin dashed toward the operating theater.
It was a race against time.
Department Director Kang hesitated for a moment before following him to the operating theater. Once he arrived at the doorway, he realized that the visitation room was already half full.

“Hey, look, Old Kang’s here. Hurry up and get over here.” Huo Congjun was abnormally enthusiastic when he saw Department Director Kang. He said, “Look, Associate Hospital Director Zhou, Department Director Kang does care about the growth of young doctors. Oh, by the way, Old Kang, there are some people I want to introduce to you. You know all the doctors here already, right? This is Mister Wang Chuanwen, and this is Mister Wang Chuanming...”

Huo Congjun had an arm over Department Director Kang’s shoulder. The latter wanted to shrug off Hou Congjun, but he was too embarrassed to do so. He looked like a rat who was being held hostage by a cat.

He knew why Huo Congjun was so enthusiastic toward him right then. The latter was definitely thinking of counting on him to save the day in case something went wrong, and Department Director Kang felt annoyed every time he thought about this.

chapters.title: Chapter 950: Yogurt
paragraphs: “Doctor Ling!”
“Doctor Ling...”
The gentlemen and ladies in the operating theater greeted Ling Ran seriously when they saw Ling Ran.
Ling Ran gave a smile that met social expectations and asked, “What’s the situation now?”

“Injury from a sharp utensil. Massive blood loss, palpitation with short breath. He has all of the medical signs from Beck’s triad...” Yu Yuan quickly reported the situation. She was the fastest learner in Ling Ran’s treatment group. When other doctors were still learning about surgeries related to the field of hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery, Yu Yuan had immediately started to learn cardiovascular surgery on her own.

Ling Ran started preoperative preparation while listening. Cardiac trauma repair was not difficult, but it depended on how fast the hospital admitted the patient and the greatest challenge depended on how fast the hospital could maintain the patient’s condition.
However, that was provided if the success rate of the hospitals and doctors were high enough, and they must try to save every patient with cardiac trauma.

And the patient in front of them was in an emergency state. Beck’s triad meant low blood pressure, expansion of the carotid artery, and weak heart sounds. They were the main symptoms of acute cardiac tamponade. If this happened in the clinical situation, such patients basically did not need any further examination to confirm that they had acute cardiac tamponade.
It was not because other examinations were useless, but the checking process was time-consuming, and the patient’s life was already flowing away.
“Open the chest.” Ling Ran did not waste his breath speaking. He went straight to cut the chest from the center.
The assistants had nothing much to say and could only cooperate with Ling Ran while there was a slight worry in their hearts.

Compared with hepatectomy or hand surgery, Ling Ran was not reputed in cardiovascular surgery and had not performed any cases with glamorous results to serve as his achievements. Therefore, many people could not help but be concerned.
The endotherm knife was placed at the center of the chest bone and incised the soft tissue.
“Goitre retractor.
“Curved forceps.
“Sternum saw. Test it.”

Ling Ran spent less than twenty seconds using each instrument before he changed to another one. However, the nurses of the Department of Surgery cooperated perfectly with him. For senior nurses who always participated in cardiovascular surgeries, the standard chest opening procedure was not difficult for them.

Wang Jia humbled herself and let the nurses of the Department of Surgery help. If she participated in a hepatectomy surgery, she could pass the instrument to the chief surgeon with her eyes closed. But if it were cardiovascular surgery, it was inevitable that she would have to learn everything again.

“Stop the ventilation.” Ling Ran turned on the sternum saw to check whether it was functioning normally. He was holding the sternum saw with a single hand, and he looked as if he was holding the thick handle of a gun.
Huo Congjun, who was at the visitation room, had stopped breathing too.

The surgery in front of him was indeed too tense for him. After all, cardiovascular surgeries were different from other internal organ surgeries. Other internal organ surgeries provided chances for the surgeon to mend their mistakes if they did any, but if anything happened during cardiovascular surgery, most of the time, there would be no chance for them to do anything about it.
Huo Congjun turned around and looked at Department Director Kang, smiling. “Old Kang, your body still looks quite fit. Do you have any secrets for maintaining such good health?”
“I’m only fifty years old.” Department Director Kang was embarrassed and angry. He was like an angry pig that was waiting for its slaughter.

Huo Congjun was not worried that Department Director Kang had just made things difficult. He still smiled like a kind old person. “When you just joined the hospital, I can still remember the time you were known as a young and promising lad. Sigh, in just the blink of an eye, you’ve become fifty years old...”

Department Director Kang snorted and disapproved of Huo Congjun’s friendly act. From his perspective, Huo Congjun’s friendly act was just like a pig breeder feeding his pigs before he could sell them. His purpose was to make them heavier and definitely not because of his love for the pigs.
However, Huo Congjun’s words still made Department Director Kang feel happy.

Young and promising was indeed the tag used to describe Department Director Kang. After all, he was a doctor who performed cardiovascular surgery. Twenty years ago, when Department Director Kang was one of the members of the Cardiothoracic Department and was the chief surgeon for cardiovascular surgery, he impressed many people. During that time, all forms of extracorporeal circulation in cardiovascular surgery were major surgeries that required everyone in the hospital to help. When there was no professional ICU around, the head nurse of the Department of Surgery would specially arrange a group of young nurses to serve Department Director Kang’s patient.

Later... because Department Director Kang was not good at maintaining and developing cardiovascular surgery, he could have already set up a Cardiovascular Surgery Center and be proud like Huo Congjun.

Anyway, when he remembered the years when he was filled with a burning passion, Department Director Kang naturally became more excited, and the way he looked at Huo Congjun became gentler. He thought, ‘If problems occur in Ling Ran’s surgery and Huo Congjun still behaves nicely, I’d go and help. It’s not a big deal for me to help, but what should I ask for? Is it too much to ask for a color doppler ultrasound in exchange?”
Department Director Kang was letting his mind run, and a faint smile was seen on his face.

Huo Congjun saw it and knew that the foundation he set up had taken effect. He then immediately slapped his thigh. “By the way, my family made me some yogurt and said that the yogurt is good for the stomach. Surprisingly, it tastes quite good. You over there, please go and take it for me from the fridge.”

The resident doctor who was nearest to the door trembled and ran out of the visitation room in such great excitement it was as if he instantly got a new name. He came back with the yogurt while panting for breath and handed it to Department Director Kang and Huo Congjun. He smiled and said, “It’s still cold.”
“If you stir it a bit, it will taste better.” Huo Congjun took the yogurt and said, “You, don’t I still have a pack of hazelnuts and dried fruits in my fridge? Please go and get it.”
“Yes.” This time around, there was another resident doctor who was beside the door was named “You”.
“Let us wait for a while.” Huo Congjun smiled, and his gaze traveled to the lower floor.

When Department Director Kang held the cold yogurt, he could sense the strong attitude from Department Director Huo. His expression became calmer while he observed Ling Ran’s operation. He said, “The chest has been sawn open. Hemostasis at the cut was well performed. As expected of a doctor who often performs hepatectomy. The incision site looks good, but if we look from the sternal angle and appendix ensiformis, it seems a bit too large.”
“The incision is too big?” Huo Congjun purposely asked Department Director Kang so that he could have a chance to speak and be pleased with himself for it.

Department Director Kang fell into the trap indeed and said, “Doctor Ling’s incision is the type shown in teaching materials. The advantage is in its full exposure. It will allow the internal part of the thoracic cavity to be seen clearly. However, we do not make such an incision anymore. The patient is a man of society as well, and he’ll still hope to look nice after the surgery. Therefore, we will usually make a smaller and shorter incision for aesthetic purposes.”
“The exposure is lower, but if you consider other aspects, it has its advantages as well.” Huo Congjun helped Department Director Kang add to his statement.
“Yes, that’s what I meant.” Department Director Kang was very satisfied with being praised. He felt that Huo Congjun was no longer as much of an eyesore when he looked at him now.

As the department director of a small department, it had been some time since Department Director Kang was treated with the sincerity and respect that a major department director like Huo Congjun received.
Department Director Kang took up the yogurt and sniffed it. He then narrowed his eyes.
“Take note of the replenishment of blood supply.” Ling Ran’s voice could be heard from the lower floor. When the nurses and doctors looked down from the visitation room, they were very tense.

If this happened at other operating theaters, the tense situation would make everyone shut up and remain silent in the surgery. Some might even let their emotions run. The chief surgeon would scold someone, while in his heart, he would curse another.
Whereas everyone in Ling Ran’s operating theater was focused, and no one even peeked at Ling Ran. That was because they were tense.

Ling Ran gently pressed on the tear in the patient’s heart with his finger, and the flowing blood immediately became thinner and slower. It was as if a river had turned into a stream, or when a man stopped peeing and was currently flicking his w*ener to clean it off.
“Suture.” Ling Ran extended his hands. When he drew it back, he poked through the heart accordingly.
First suture...
Second suture...
“Okay. We’re done with the suture.” Ling Ran had made two sutures and sutured the cardiac tear, which was not too large.
Cardiorrhaphy was commonly used for small traumatic wounds like this. Patients who had larger wounds would have a drastically lower chance of surviving before they reached the hospital.
Everyone in the operating theater and visitation room was relieved.
*Bang*
The second-generation “You” pushed open the door of the visitation room and brought with him a basket of dried fruits, hazelnuts, and preserved fruits.

Huo Congjun looked downward and saw that they were finishing off the surgery. Then, he looked at the basket. He found it a waste as he picked up one-quarter of the walnuts, put it into Department Director Kang’s yogurt, and said, “Eat it.”
